evidence.claim: A key outside its validity window is rejected for verification, and an in-window key on the same publisher is accepted in the same run.

A static AST audit of tools/marketplace (excluding tests) finds zero key-generation/rotation/deletion call paths, and the same auditor reports a planted rotate_key / generate_private_key plant (non-vacuous).

implementation.notes: Fixture public material is RFC 8032 Ed25519 test-vector public keys. No private keys are stored. Cryptographic signature verify is IMP-0077.

negative_controls.description: In-window key must verify successfully in the same run that rejects the expired key.
Auditor must find a planted rotate_key/generate_private_key; a silent auditor fails the unit.

notes: G-1 for IMP-0075: live named probes exit 0, receipt state=SUCCESS, per-unit manifest row. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. Did not create, rotate, revoke, or print keys.
question: Model publisher identity (id, display name, public keys with validity windows, contact) and document custody: the owner creates, holds and rotates keys personally; no tool in this program may create, rotate, revoke or regenerate a key. Implement only the consumption side plus a validity-window check.

retry.policy: no automatic retry on anything key-related; escalate to the owner
